question: What are some good toys to keep my dog mentally stimulated?
user: What are some good toys to keep my dog mentally stimulated?
response: Giving your dog puzzle toys that require them to "figure things out" can be great for their mental stimulation. Try filling a Kong with peanut butter and hiding it inside a Kong-shaped puzzle toy. This makes your dog work harder to get the food out, which keeps them mentally engaged. You can also use a non-toxic, moldable toy and encourage your dog to chew it loudly to make a mess, as this can help release pent-up energy and distract them from destructive behavior. Another option is to allow your dog to chew on teeth-strengthening chews that have a gritty texture, which can be more satisfying than standard toys. If your dog shows aggression or anxiety, mixing in some rawhide or similar items can give them an outlet for stress.
